title: Census of India 2027: counting dates and self-enumeration window
issued_by: Registrar General of India and Census Commissioner (Ministry of Home Affairs); republished in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette by the Public Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
reference_number: S.O.5913(E); Tamil Nadu Notification No. II(1)/PULO/23(f)/2026
says: The population census will be done from 25 January 2027 to 28 February 2027, with a check-again round from 1 to 5 March 2027. Before the house-to-house counting starts, people can fill in their own details (self-enumeration) from 10 to 24 January 2027.
what_to_do: If you wish, fill in your own census details through self-enumeration between 10 and 24 January 2027; otherwise census staff will come house to house.
by_when: Self-enumeration: 10-24 January 2027. House-to-house counting: 25 January - 28 February 2027 (revisional round 1-5 March 2027).
who_it_affects: Everyone living in Tamil Nadu. The order covers all States and Union territories except those it lists (Manipur for now, Goa, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Ladakh and snow-bound areas of Himachal Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir).
